sources.rights_or_public_access_basis: Public-alert products are available through official public services and brokers

sources.known_limitations: CTAS retains metadata and provider links only; it does not mirror article full text or infer reuse rights from discoverability
sources.name: NASA Astrophysics Data System
sources.rate_or_cadence_limit: One exact-name query per watched-target refresh; at most 25 metadata records
sources.rights_or_public_access_basis: Public bibliographic metadata returned by the ADS API

sources.authentication_requirement: Authorization: Token header; credentials remain local and are never published.
sources.known_limitations: The API is authenticated and every observer contribution, AUID, band, observation type, uncertainty, upper-limit flag, and required credit must remain source-native
sources.name: AAVSO International Database Photometry
sources.pagination_policy: Follow count/next/previous/results until next is null; the official API does not document a page-size control or hard row ceiling.
sources.rate_or_cadence_limit: No more than one request every 10 seconds without AAVSO approval.
sources.redistribution_constraint: AAVSO and contributing observers require acknowledgment; observer codes and upper-limit semantics must be preserved.
sources.rights_or_public_access_basis: AID observations are available for research and publication subject to AAVSO's current Data Usage Guidelines

sources.authentication_requirement: None for the latest public release
sources.known_limitations: Release photometry may lag real time and is neither alert difference photometry nor forced photometry; coordinate association does not assert identity
sources.name: ZTF Public Data-Release Light Curves at IRSA
sources.rate_or_cadence_limit: One 1.5-arcsec target cone, bounded discovery window, 20,000-row and 12 MB fail-closed caps
sources.rights_or_public_access_basis: Only the latest anonymous public data-release collection is queried

sources.known_limitations: Circular prose is retained as an attributed author report; values are not promoted to machine measurements without a mission-specific parser
sources.name: NASA GCN Circulars
sources.protocol: GCN Kafka JSON / public Circular archive
sources.rate_or_cadence_limit: Persistent Kafka consumer; revisions are checksum-addressed and linked URLs are not bulk-downloaded
sources.rights_or_public_access_basis: Released GCN Circular author text, metadata, corrections, and provider-hosted links are publicly distributed

sources.known_limitations: Draft, private, ambiguous, authenticated-only, non-text, or unsupported table material is refused; only source-linked bounded public photometry text is parsed
sources.name: TNS AstroNotes
sources.protocol: Anonymous public HTML + allowlisted public plain-text attachments
sources.rate_or_cadence_limit: Bounded latest-page poll every 30 minutes
sources.rights_or_public_access_basis: Pages explicitly marked note-public with a release timestamp

sources.known_limitations: Observer credit, AAVSO acknowledgment/facility keyword, validation state, and current usage guidance must be retained; anonymous availability is verified per record
sources.name: AAVSO AVSpec Published Spectra
sources.protocol: Anonymous AVSpec HTML search + public ZIP/FITS download
sources.rate_or_cadence_limit: One five-arcsec discovery-window search and at most ten public spectrum downloads per explicit target refresh
sources.rights_or_public_access_basis: The anonymous search interface explicitly returns published observations; AAVSO permits publication use subject to its current Data Usage Guidelines

sources.authentication_requirement: TNS bot marker and API key
sources.known_limitations: A credential can expose group-proprietary records. Object and spectrum public flags are mandatory; current photometry rows lack per-row visibility and are refused
sources.name: TNS Public Object Details and Spectra
sources.protocol: TNS 2.0 Get Object API + provider-hosted public file
sources.rate_or_cadence_limit: Provider quota; one bounded exact-object query and at most ten public ASCII preview downloads per explicit target enrichment
sources.rights_or_public_access_basis: Only objects explicitly marked public=1 and spectrum rows explicitly marked public=1

sources.known_limitations: Private scripted access requires a personal API key; this adapter sends no credentials, refuses any row without public=1, and never treats repository membership as a new detection
sources.name: WISeREP Public Spectra
sources.protocol: Anonymous exact-name ZIP export with JSON metadata and ASCII spectra
sources.rate_or_cadence_limit: One exact-target export, at most 24 complete rows, per explicit refresh
sources.rights_or_public_access_basis: Only anonymous public=yes export rows independently marked public=1
